judge.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token usage across provider calls in `chatOrchestrator.ts` and renames the hook parameter to `totalUsage`, matching the core logic of the reference PR. It also defines a documented type alias `TurnUsageMetadata = UsageMetadata` in `src/types/ai.ts` (specifically hinted at by the ticket's key files and acceptance criteria) and tests a true two-tool-round (three provider calls) scenario as requested. However, rather than adding the new tests to the existing `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` suite where `scriptedProvider` already existed, the candidate creates three separate test/support files and modifies `jest.config.js`. Additionally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate leaves the new behavior under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section instead of moving it to the active behavioral spec section and updating `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` like the reference did.
